title: MapClass
summary: Specification for a dense pixel-level terrain segmentation system for grand-strategy style maps at 100–2000 km scale, covering 9-class land cover and 3-class topography.
notes: Manifest assigned SPEC; README functions as the de-facto project specification and locks multiple technical commitments: LoRA on SigLIP attention layers only (q_proj/k_proj/v_proj/out_proj) with frozen Gemma, ESA WorldCover from s3://esa-worldcover, Copernicus DEM GLO-30 from s3://copernicus-dem-30m, 9-class land cover taxonomy, 3-class topography from slope thresholds (<2°, 2–15°, >15°), regional scale 100–2000 km, joint per-pixel NLL metric on held-out synthetic maps, and Allmaps/Georeferencer-driven IIIF georeferencing workflow.
